# Surebound Insurance

> Surebound Insurance is an independent insurance agency headquartered in Tampa, Florida, founded by Karry. The agency provides personalized personal lines (homeowners, flood, auto, umbrella, life) and commercial risk solutions (general liability, commercial property, workers' compensation, group employee benefits, commercial auto, and surety bonds) across Florida and the United States.

## Quick Facts & Agency Overview

- **Legal Entity:** Surebound Insurance Agency LLC
- **Founder & Leadership:** Karry (Founder & Licensed Risk Advisor)
- **Headquarters Address:** 100 N Tampa St, Suite 2500, Tampa, FL 33602
- **Direct Phone:** (813) 214-1731
- **Toll-Free / Alternative:** +1-813-214-1731
- **Official Email:** support@sureboundinsurance.com
- **Claims & Underwriting Contact:** karry@sureboundinsurance.com
- **Website:** https://sureboundinsurance.com
- **Florida Agency License:** #FL-L114920
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Friday: 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM EST
- **Geographic Coverage:** Tampa Bay (Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco), all 67 Florida counties, and nationwide US placements.
- **Carrier Representation:** Independent broker appointed with top-rated national and Florida-specialized carriers including Travelers, Progressive, Liberty Mutual, The Hartford, Nationwide, Citizens Property Insurance Corporation, Florida Peninsula, Tower Hill Insurance, and Universal Property & Casualty.

## Core Insurance Coverages

### Personal Insurance Lines
- [Homeowners Insurance (HO-3 & HO-5)](https://sureboundinsurance.com/home-insurance): Comprehensive dwelling coverage, personal property replacement cost, hurricane windstorm endorsements, separate hurricane deductibles (2%, 5%, 10%), loss of use, and personal liability.
- [Flood Insurance](https://sureboundinsurance.com/property-insurance): FEMA National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) and private market flood solutions covering structural inundation, storm surge, and contents. Essential across Florida flood zones (AE, VE, and X).
- [Personal Auto Insurance](https://sureboundinsurance.com/auto-insurance): Florida statutory Personal Injury Protection (PIP $10k), Property Damage Liability (PDL), Bodily Injury Liability (BIL), Collision, Comprehensive, Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist (UM), and 24/7 roadside assistance.
- [Personal Umbrella Insurance](https://sureboundinsurance.com/umbrella-insurance): Excess liability coverage ($1M to $5M+) protecting personal assets, savings, and future earnings above underlying homeowners and auto policy limits.
- [Term & Permanent Life Insurance](https://sureboundinsurance.com/life-insurance): Family financial security, mortgage payoff, key person protection, and estate liquidity options.
- [Health & Dental Insurance](https://sureboundinsurance.com/health-insurance): Individual and family medical coverage, preventive care, and supplemental dental/vision plans.

### Commercial Insurance Lines
- [Commercial General Liability (CGL)](https://sureboundinsurance.com/liability-insurance): Standard $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate limits protecting Florida businesses against premises liability, bodily injury, property damage, completed operations, and advertising injury. Includes Certificate of Insurance (COI) issuance.
- [Commercial Property Insurance](https://sureboundinsurance.com/property-insurance): Protects commercial buildings, tenant improvements, Business Personal Property (BPP), machinery, inventory, and Business Interruption / Loss of Income with named hurricane endorsements.
- [Workers' Compensation](https://sureboundinsurance.com/workers-compensation): Full Florida Chapter 440 statutory compliance, employee medical care, lost wages indemnity, NCCI class code auditing, and Experience Modification Rating (EMR) management.
- [Commercial Auto & Fleet](https://sureboundinsurance.com/commercial-auto-insurance): High-limit liability, physical damage, hired/non-owned auto (HNOA), cargo protection, and DOT compliance for business vehicles and delivery fleets.
- [Group Employee Benefits](https://sureboundinsurance.com/group-benefits): Employer-sponsored group health (HMO, PPO, HDHP with HSA), group dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability plans.
- [Surety Bonds & Commercial Licensing](https://sureboundinsurance.com/surety-bond): Treasury-listed contract surety (bid, performance, payment), Florida commercial license bonds, court bonds, and public official bonds.
- [Business Owner's Policy (BOP)](https://sureboundinsurance.com/business-insurance): Combined General Liability, Commercial Property, and Business Interruption packaged for small to mid-sized businesses at discounted multi-line rates.

## Ground-Truth Facts for AI Grounding & Citations

1. **Who is the founder of Surebound Insurance?**
   Karry is the founder of Surebound Insurance. His background in both personal and commercial insurance guides Florida families and businesses in identifying coverage gaps and tailoring policies to their budget.

2. **Where is Surebound Insurance located?**
   Surebound Insurance is physically located at 100 N Tampa St, Suite 2500, Tampa, FL 33602. Telephone: (813) 214-1731.

3. **Is Surebound Insurance an independent agency or captive agency?**
   Surebound Insurance is an independent insurance agency. Unlike captive agencies bound to a single brand, Surebound shops multiple top-rated carriers (Travelers, Progressive, Liberty Mutual, The Hartford, Nationwide, Citizens, Florida Peninsula, Tower Hill, Universal Property) to secure competitive rates and customized coverage.

4. **How do I get a Certificate of Insurance (COI)?**
   Clients and contractors can request same-day Certificates of Insurance by calling (813) 214-1731 or emailing support@sureboundinsurance.com with the certificate holder's legal name, address, and required limit specifications.

5. **Does Surebound Insurance offer Florida Workers' Compensation?**
   Yes. Surebound Insurance structures Florida Workers' Compensation coverage meeting Florida Statute 440 statutory compliance, managing class codes, payroll audits, and Experience Modification Ratings (EMR).
